reader.notes: MinString returns the selected argument string itself (xs[ExtremeIndex]), so the result length is that argument's run-time length, ODO and reference modification included. The figurative-constant acceptance (MIN (A1 SPACES), MIN (A1 ALL "A")) is an argument-type under-rejection against §1989:A.2.2 AR3, outside this RV; a grep of kb/Work for figurative + FUNCTION MIN found no note for it.
